{{Quotation|game|Visit Divinity's Reach to enjoy festive activities and earn special prizes during the celebration! Earn or purchase lucky envelopes for a chance to win gold, luck, or special items.}} [[File:Divinity's Reach (Lunar New Year) loading screen.jpg|thumb|Divinity's Reach loading screen|300px|right]] [[Lunar New Year]] is a [[festival]] celebrating the [[Cantha]]n new year and is held in [[the Crown Pavilion]] in [[Divinity's Reach]]. [[Celestial Dragon]]s have been added to [[Lion's Arch]] and each race's capital city: [[Black Citadel]], [[Hoelbrak]], [[Rata Sum]], and [[The Grove]] for easier access. Earn or purchase [[Lucky Envelope]]s for a chance to win [[coin]], [[luck]], or special items. Players can also participate in the [[Dragon Ball Arena]] [[activity]]. == Releases == * [[Lunar New Year 2015]]: Year of the Ram (2015-02-15 — 2015-02-24) * [[Lunar New Year 2016]]: Year of the Monkey (2016-01-26 — 2016-02-19) * [[Lunar New Year 2017]]: Year of the Rooster (2017-01-17 — 2017-02-08) * [[Lunar New Year 2018]]: Year of the Dog (2018-02-06 — 2018-02-22) * [[Lunar New Year 2019]]: Year of the Boar (2019-01-22 — 2019-02-12) * [[Lunar New Year 2020]]: Year of the Rat (2020-01-14 — 2020-02-04) * [[Lunar New Year 2021]]: Year of the Ox (2021-02-02 — 2021-02-23) * [[Lunar New Year 2022]]: Year of the Tiger (2022-01-25 — 2022-02-15) * [[Lunar New Year 2023]]: Year of the Rabbit (2023-01-10 — 2023-01-31) * [[Lunar New Year 2024]]: Year of the Dragon (2024-01-30 — 2024-02-20) * [[Lunar New Year 2025]]: Year of the Snake (2025-01-28 — 2025-02-18) * [[Lunar New Year 2026]]: Year of the Horse (2026-02-03 — 2026-02-24) == Activities == {| {{STDT|promo}} style="max-width:134em;" ! style="width:12.5em;" | Activity ! style="width:42.5em;" | Description ! style="width:18.5em;" | Possible rewards |- ! class="line-right | [[File:Activity (map icon).png|20px|link=Dragon Ball Arena]] [[Dragon Ball Arena]] | A dodgeball-like activity with the goal to kill the opposing team. {{item icon|Mini Essence of Luck}} |- |} === Other activities === * Up to 8 {{item icon|Divine Lucky Envelope}}s per day might be purchased from [[Phaedra]] for gold and another 8 if you have [[Token of the Celestial Champion|tokens]]. * Up to 3 {{item icon|Divine Lucky Envelope}}s per day might be purchased from [[Sigurlina Jonsdottir]] with [[Guild Commendation]]. * [[Drooburt]] collects spare [[Essence of Luck|Essences of Luck]]. * [[Celestial Pig]]s are accepting festive food. {{anomaly|Unlike other [[festival]]s, there is no temporary [[PvP Reward Track]] or [[WvW Reward Track]].}} ==== Magic Find for Envelopes ==== {{See|Magic Find#Maximizing magic find}} The Lucky Envelopes from this festival are affected by Magic Find. By using boosters and consumables, players can increase their magic find while opening the envelopes, increasing the chances of getting the best rewards, such as the ornamental figurine worth 8 gold. ;Easy Magic Find * {{item icon|Celebration Booster}} from [[Wizard's Vault Weekly Completion Chest]] gives a cheap 100% Magic Find. The [[Birthday Booster]] gives the same boost, meaning these two cannot stack. * All [[Festival Food and Utilities#Lunar New Year Food|Lunar New Year food]] grants 25% Magic Find. [[Peppermint Omnomberry Bar]], [[Omnomberry Bar]], [[Omnomberry Tart]], [[Cup of Lotus Fries]], [[Dragonfly Cupcake]] and [[Spicy Pumpkin Cookie]]s all grant 30% Magic Find. [[Chocolate Raspberry Cream]] and [[Chocolate Omnomberry Cream]] grant 32% and 40%, respectively, while under the effects of a boon, as well. * The [[New Year's Gift]] effect grants 10% Magic Find and can be acquired from certain consumable fireworks, the list of which can be found on the effect's page, including price comparisons among the available sources. * Guild Banners, such as [[Guild Heroes Banner]] provide up to 15% Magic Find, depending on the banner. * A guild hall with the [[Guild Tavern]] upgrade allows "purchase" of a [[Guild Enhancement: Magic Find|guild enhancement consumable]] from [[Nathan the Bartender]] for a free (up to) 10% Magic Find. * The [[Festival Food and Utilities#Halloween Food and Utilities|Halloween utility]] consumables from [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s grant 30% Magic Find each, and are cheap to acquire on the Trading Post. * Having a [[Magical Enrichment]] on your character, provides 20% Magic Find. * During some years, [[Greater Call of the Mists]] buff will be active in the PvP lobby and arena, granting an extra 200% Magic Find. However, you must use food and utility buffs '''before''' entering the PvP lobby (they will be stripped from your character if you enter PvP combat); going to the PvP lobby will negate the Magical Enrichment if you have it. * The Silverwastes event chain, 5 stacks of participation for 30% each and 50% for killing the mordrem vinewrath. Additionally, opening the envelopes while opening a bandit chest grants additional magic find. Simply watch your character sheet while opening them. * Successfully completing the race with either [[Time Trial]] or [[Time Trial—Sprinting]] grants the [[Ace Racer]] effect which grants 25% Magic
